email.body1:
Travis, saw Dealerslink shipped the 2026 AI Suite and pulled a record 1,400+ dealers to the NADA booth.

That kind of demand surge usually means more in-market dealers than the team can follow up with before interest cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dealerslink off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Travis, quick follow-up for Dealerslink.

After a booth haul like NADA, the follow-up volume usually outruns what reps can personalize, so the warmest dealers get a generic touch or none at all. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to convert that interest into the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Dealerslink needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Travis, last bit of proof for Dealerslink.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dealerslink's reply rate likely compares to other vertical SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Travis, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dealer pipeline without adding reps is not a priority right after NADA, no problem at all. Post-show follow-up is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a dealer sales motion? I will tailor it to Dealerslink either way.
